name: Olist marketplace
story: A Brazilian online marketplace where independent sellers list products and Olist handles orders, payments and delivery. About 99k orders from Sep 2016 to Oct 2018.

source.title: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist

tables.name: dim_customers
tables.description: One row per order-level customer record. customer_id is created per order; customer_unique_id identifies the person.
tables.grain: One row per order-level customer record

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Key used by fct_orders. One per order, so it is not a person.

columns.name: customer_unique_id
columns.description: The real customer. Use COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) for customers and repeat purchase.

columns.name: zip_code_prefix
columns.description: First 5 digits of the customer zip code

columns.name: state
columns.description: Two-letter Brazilian state code (SP, RJ, MG, ...)

tables.name: dim_products
tables.description: One row per product listed by a seller.
tables.grain: One row per product listed by a seller

columns.name: category_pt
columns.description: Original Portuguese category name, null for 610 products

columns.name: category
columns.description: English category name; 'unknown' when missing, Portuguese when no translation exists

tables.name: dim_sellers
tables.description: One row per seller on the marketplace.
tables.grain: One row per seller on the marketplace

columns.name: zip_code_prefix
columns.description: First 5 digits of the seller zip code

columns.name: city
columns.description: Seller city (a few values are dirty)

tables.name: fct_order_items
tables.description: One row per item in an order. An order with two units of a product has two rows.
tables.grain: One row per item in an order

columns.name: item_seq
columns.description: Item number within the order, starting at 1

columns.name: purchased_at
columns.description: Order purchase time (copied from the order)

columns.name: shipping_limit_at
columns.description: Deadline for the seller to hand the item to the carrier

columns.name: price
columns.description: Item price in BRL, excluding freight

columns.name: freight_value
columns.description: Freight charged for this item in BRL

tables.name: fct_payments
tables.description: One row per payment method used on an order. Orders paid with a voucher plus a card have several rows.
tables.grain: One row per payment method used on an order

columns.name: payment_seq
columns.description: Sequence of the payment within the order

columns.name: payment_type
columns.description: credit_card, boleto (bank slip), voucher, debit_card, not_defined

columns.name: payment_value
columns.description: Amount paid with this method in BRL

tables.name: fct_reviews
tables.description: One row per review response. Customers rate the order 1 to 5 after delivery; comments are in Portuguese.

columns.name: review_id
columns.description: Review key; 814 ids repeat across orders

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Order reviewed; a few orders have more than one review

columns.name: has_comment
columns.description: True when a title or message was written

columns.name: sent_at
columns.description: When the satisfaction survey was sent

tables.name: fct_orders
tables.description: One row per order, with item, payment, delivery and review rollups.
tables.grain: One row per order, with item, payment, delivery and review rollups

columns.name: customer_unique_id
columns.description: The real customer, copied for convenience

columns.name: order_status
columns.description: delivered, shipped, canceled, unavailable, invoiced, processing, created, approved

columns.name: items_value
columns.description: Sum of item prices in BRL (gross merchandise value, GMV)

columns.name: payment_value
columns.description: Sum of payments in BRL (items plus freight, sometimes plus interest)

columns.name: is_late
columns.description: Delivered more than one day after the estimated date; null if not delivered

columns.name: review_score
columns.description: Average review score for the order (1 to 5), null if no review

metrics.name: gmv
metrics.description: Gross merchandise value: item prices, excluding freight. Exclude canceled and unavailable orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(items_value) FROM olist.fct_orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

metrics.name: orders
metrics.description: Orders placed, excluding canceled and unavailable
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist.fct_orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

metrics.name: aov
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(items_value)/COUNT(*) FROM olist.fct_orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

metrics.name: repeat_rate
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG((n>1)::INT) FROM (SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) n FROM olist.fct_orders GROUP BY 1)

metrics.name: late_delivery_rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered orders that arrived late
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG(is_late::INT) FROM olist.fct_orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND is_late IS NOT NULL

caveats: Data collection tapers off after Aug 2018; Sep and Oct 2018 have only a handful of orders, so exclude them from trends.
customer_id is one per order. Count people with customer_unique_id.
Geolocation (lat/long by zip) is not loaded to keep the warehouse small.
questions: Which product categories grew fastest in 2018?
Does late delivery lower review scores? Show it.
What share of customers buy twice, and how long until they return?
Which states have the worst late-delivery rate?
